change.title: stripe-node v23: webhooks.signature.verifyHeader/verifyHeaderAsync now apply default timestamp tolerance; constructEvent tolerance 0 skips verification

source.quote: Passing 0 to stripe.webhooks.constructEvent now properly skips timestamp tolerance verification.

task.notes: This only applies after upgrading stripe-node to v23. The repo is on 20.0.0. If the constructEvent call passes an explicit tolerance of 0, a v23 upgrade would silently disable timestamp verification. The migration agent should inspect lib/billing/stripe.ts:252 for a tolerance argument. If none is passed, there is no impact.
